description: You feel alien in your own body, as if part of you remained behind with the storm.  You will suffer severely when not exposed to portal storms unless you find a way to anchor yourself to the world again.
You have regained some substance and have stabilized somewhat, if not entirely.  Portal storm withdrawal will not affect you as strongly as before.

In the tunnel at LIXA, you were inside of an impossible shape, where the X, Y, and Z axis were mere suggestions.  When you put the shape out of its misery, (as much misery as a concept can have), you saw it for what it was; just a shape.  You can now visualize "impossible" shapes in your mind's eye, rendering them mundane to you.
Something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.
You shouldn't see this.  This makes you spawn tainted shadows.

You can hear your heartbeat in your ears, feel the blood sloshing around in your veins.  The uneven hitches in your breath, the aches in your joints, the rumbling of your stomach.  It's nasty and messy and ugly.  And you are extremely grateful for that.
All the horrors you saw in that place inured you to them.  You have some protection against mental attacks.
Venturing that far in the place behind the storms attuned you to them.  Being outside during a portal storm or in the dimension it leads to will randomly cause beneficial effects.
This place filled with artefacts possessing unknown properties impacted you.  You now resonate like they do, but in a way that lessens the risks of carrying too many of them at once.
That place you entered left its mark on you.  When you receive a beneficial effect from interacting with possibilities, it lasts twice as long.
That place you entered left its mark on you.  When you receive a beneficial item from interacting with possibilities, you gain twice as many.

Having explored the portal storm dimension made it easier to see where its denizens are.  You now see beings born from the storms and from that place even through walls, though you still need your eyes to see beings from elsewhere.

descriptions.text: You sense a stormwrought being here.
